quest.title: Raiders Amidst Snow Mist
quest.description: All proceeds smoothly. You plan to search for Albedo to discuss the changes the sword has undergone further.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon: Act III
chapter.title: Raiders Amidst Snow Mist

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo! We're back~!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey, does he have a guest over?

choices.text: Yes, and a familiar one at that.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Yes, perhaps it is too soon to ask our greenhorns to come adventuring here...

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: But adventure is nothing if it is not about pushing our limits! What is a journey without struggle, without excitement?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: This place may be infested with wicked hilichurl bandits and knee-deep snow, but an adventurer must never stop pressing forward!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Cyrus, to the point, please.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hahaha! Come, come! The beauty of a chat lies in the journey, not the destination — just like an adventure!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Even if you are robbed blind and must give up on your encampment, you can start a fire and cook a meal in the frigid snow!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: This journey up the mountain will be an unforgettable one for all our newcomers!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Mm, yes.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: They may resent me, or even hate me. But in the future, they will think back upon this moment with hearts full of gratitude — for this was the day that the spirit of adventure was passed on to them!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Oh yes, go on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh brother... Albedo's at it again. He's always so cold when the topic doesn't catch his fancy...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He isn't interested in adventurers in the slightest, is he?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He sure is interested in you, though.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Still... should we say that our newcomers are too green, or that the mountain is too mighty? We have taken great losses this time...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? What do you mean, "great losses"?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Oh, you must be...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's up, Cyrus?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Long time no see—!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: #Ah, yes! The young adventurer and {M#his}{F#her} companion! It is my pleasure to see you here.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: I trust these frigid ascents have not given you too much trouble?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ha, we can take anything it has to throw at us!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hahaha! Good, good! I love your confidence!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: But you must be here on some important duty, braving the wind and snow like this.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: #I came here to gather the latest data on hilichurls, and asked {M#him}{F#her} to serve as my assistant.

choices.text: (Huh. Is that how it went?)

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Ah, I see. A gathering of people chasing their dreams and ideals, is it?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Then I wish you all the best. Farewell for now — I must go see to our new recruits.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haha, looks like we've made a discovery!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Albedo is keeping Cyrus in the dark.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it is a magical sword after all. It's understandable that he doesn't want other people to know about it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I am listening, you know...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Should I not ask?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: There is no "should" or "shouldn't" here. I can answer your questions...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But not right now. Right now, I have more pressing matters on hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Pressing matters"? ...Let Paimon guess, we've got a part to play in it too, huh?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hehe. You're getting smarter, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon will have you know that she's always been smart!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I have discovered some new habitats nearby with different monster types. I believe they will provide us with similarly varied data.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sure love your research, don't you?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Perseverance is key to research, and persistence is the basis of the alchemist's art.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: So, are you ready? Then let us go.

choices.text: (Quite reluctant to let people in on the matter of that sword, isn't he?)
Now, where have we seen this face before?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: We must get the book back, it has my notes and sketches in it.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm. It seems that no one is here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do monsters go out to run errands too?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Well then, would you like to take a look around before they return, or shall we rest a while here?

choices.text: How does a rest and a leisurely talk sound?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Just what I was thinking.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, we're having a chat now? Paimon wants in!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I know you must have questions, whether it be about me, or about this entire situation. As I said before, I will answer them.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But I will not deceive you. There are some things I cannot go into detail on. On these matters, you'll have to permit me to summarize a bit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Guess Albedo can be pretty straightforward when he wants to be...

choices.text: More earnest than I expected, for sure.

response.text: Tiga plata!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh huh! ...Eh, what?
Odomu Movo!

choices.text: Are you making those strange noises, Albedo?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Do you really think that's possible?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ah, hilichurls!

choices.text: Are you making those strange noises, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you think? And why aren't you asking Albedo, huh?

choices.text: More carefree than I expected, for sure.
Great idea — I have some questions.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Alright. What would you like to ask?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo, how's the sketchbook situation?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's alright. A few pages were destroyed, but most of it is intact.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The temperature in the Snowy Mountain is subzero. It can reach extremely low temperatures, especially near that cavern.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What makes matters worse is that the hilichurls have drooled all over the pages. To leave wet paper in such low temperatures, it's too dreadful to imagine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Frozen paper is so brittle. It doesn't take much for it to fall apart, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fortunately, you knew how to piece it back together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No wonder you're an alchemist! Such an ingenious mind!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If the sketchbook had been severely damaged, you'd be furious, wouldn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: What leads you to believe that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You told us there's a lot of drawings and notes inside.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I must admit, I bring this sketchbook everywhere I go.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: However, I wouldn't fly into a rage over such a thing.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Had I not been able to salvage it, I would just draw everything again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh... How pragmatic of you...

choices.text: I don't think so.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Is that so?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: After all, you've put a lot of effort into your drawings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Think of all the memories you've committed to paper.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep yep!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Such mementos shouldn't be easily abandoned.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Absolutely! All well said. You took the words out of Paimon's mouth, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm... You're right. Redrawing everything would be a tedious endeavor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Especially since you're so talented, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You've mastered so many skills and gathered so much knowledge that other people can only dream of!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But such talented people sometimes forget about that. It's one of the downsides of being smart, isn't it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Albedo's also praised your smarts, Paimon.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Without a doubt, Paimon is an interesting creature.

choices.text: Paimon forgets about the little things, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhhh! Don't put Paimon on the spot when it comes to wisdom!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Changing the subject... Cyrus told me that the hilichurls from this mountain attack and rob adventurers.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The place we visited should be one of their camps.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The hilichurls in this area are strong.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, the hilichurls here are way stronger than the ones at the bottom of the mountain.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I can't disagree. I assume... this must be related to the dragon.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The corruptive power emanating from Durin's remains is making the monsters stronger, which, in tandem with the frigid climate, depopulated some mountain areas.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Can you take out the sword, Traveler?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Each time you fought in the mountains, this sword was absorbing power and storing it within itself.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Moreover, thanks to your purification, the corruptive power of the dragon's blood seems to be all gone now.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's a very interesting phenomenon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not the first time we've done something like that. We're experts!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I always wondered what purification was capable of... I knew you were capable of doing it, but seeing it with my own eyes is a unique experience.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A power-absorbing sword must be quite dangerous.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Indeed, I can't say it's the safest of weapons.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lucky that it wasn't snatched away by those hilichurls, otherwise we'd be done for!

choices.text: Aren't Fatui a bigger threat?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hilichurls are a threat, too! What if that power could turn them into... super, no, ultra hilichurls!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ultra hilichurls!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ultra demon hilichurls!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ultra demon snowman hilichurls!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Snowman"? Now you've ruined the game...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, about the sword... If it's so powerful, can't it absorb your energy as well, Albedo?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Would you like to try it out?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes! Such a cold gaze!

choices.text: Paimon was just joking...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's fine. After all, I still hope you'll continue to use this sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You still trust us? Even though this sword is so dangerous? Well that was unexpected.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Albedo, you say one thing but do another... Paimon can never tell what's really on your mind!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I have no idea what you're talking about...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But if you want to know why I trust you... It might be because...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The "unusual" ones like us share a certain degree of understanding.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Unusual ones?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Lonely individuals... Those who aren't like ordinary people. Just like... you and me.

choices.text: (Is he implying something?)
Paimon didn't mean anything bad...
Aren't Treasure Horders a bigger threat?
I don't think Paimon has the same problem.
If that happened to me, I'd get mad!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you see that? That hilichurl ran off while holding on to something that looks like a book!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That's... not good. That was my sketchbook.

choices.text: Perhaps it dreams of becoming a grand-master artist someday?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks it's just your run-of-the-mill thief, really.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To think that it dared to steal my sketchbook. Quite bold, this one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, looks like Albedo's got a frosty temper...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll lend you a hand.

choices.text: Did it want to learn alchemy too?

talks.objective: Follow the footprints to tail the hilichurl
Follow the footprints to tail the hilichurl
Follow the footprints to tail the hilichurl
Follow the footprints to tail the hilichurl

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This is the monsters' camp. It seems that the birds have brought their plunder back to their nest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get in there!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: No, our best option is to find a way to lure them out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like it's a dead end. You know, except for this huge cavern entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did it run in there?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Judging from the tracks, that seems to be the case.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then what are we waiting for!? We can't let it escape!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Wait.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This mountain is incredibly large. Even if there was a path within its bowels, such a road would not be easy to walk.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Can you feel it? The wind carries the scent of ice and stone with it... and the sound of echoes. The space within must be massive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: As such, rash moves are of no benefit to us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... But we've come all this way — we can't just let it leave!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't that sketchbook very important to you?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is. But that doesn't mean that we should act recklessly.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There is another way. It just requires some extra work.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If my guess is correct, this cavern's exit is on the other side of the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You are quite the expert glider, and I'm a fair hand myself. So prepare yourself, and we'll glide across in one go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We gotta hurry up, before it gets too far away!

talks.objective: Use the wind current to catch up with the hilichurl

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's our sketchbook — and it was on the head honcho, as expected!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Ugh... There's been some damage...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I need to head back to see if there's anything I can salvage. Let's meet at the alchemy stall in Mondstadt later, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Albedo looked like he was in quite a hurry. Guess those who can't appreciate art shouldn't be able to handle it, huh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there's a camp over there!

talks.objective: Activate the device and lure the hilichurls out
Defeat all opponents and retrieve the sketchbook

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's so many of them! Are they trying to surround us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These guys are pretty smart... Is this also the influence of Durin's body?

talks.objective: Return to the campsite and look for Albedo

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! It's running off, and there's something in its hands!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The paths we may venture are not limited to those the eye can see.
